decisions.reason: Indoor air quality sensing remains a strong fit with the platform and has become more relevant for schools, buildings and lab projects, so we would continue to support it.
As the current generation of a core voltage-measurement module, it serves a basic platform function and is unlikely to be withdrawn without a direct successor.
The MQTT proxy strengthens software connectivity at relatively low maintenance cost, making it strategically useful to retain.
A dedicated CO2 sensor module matches customer demand in education, automation and indoor monitoring and therefore remains commercially and strategically attractive.
The touch panel is still the most optional and accessory-like item in the group, but it complements control and prototyping use cases enough to keep for now.
